summary: R201B executed the reviewed rank objective and remained worse on normal retrieval than original DeMo and R201A FIXED. The selected private-only block preserves original normal metrics; the shared public block is the observed harmful normal-fusion component. R201B has no frequency expert, so it supplies no RGBNT201 PM/PF bottleneck evidence. The smallest next step is an RGBNT201 native interface diagnostic comparing P(x) against x+P(x) on identical original-E28-frozen expert states and actual routed evidence, equally in ordinary-frequency and dual-axis variants. Keep this one interface factor separate from relation-conditioned F pooling, private-coordinate injection and removal of the fixed public25 metric. No current builder already implements the whole requested combination.

actual_code_evidence_connection.scope: Read existing local primary/analysis receipts and reduced the normal paired CSV rows. No new server audit, archive verification, model execution or general scientific acceptance was performed.

evidence_findings.finding: Ranking was exercised and did not repair normal retrieval at this tested setting.
evidence_findings.interpretation: The positive native rank losses, eligible-query records and 2647 successful updates connect the negative result to the intended implementation. It is one seed and one temperature/weight choice, not proof that every ranking objective must fail. No further loss stack or sampler change is justified by this review.

evidence_findings.finding: Protected private identity survives; fixed public25 fusion causes the observed selected normal readout to be worse.
evidence_findings.interpretation: Private-only equals the original six metrics and per-query AP/Rank1 outcomes; strip-and-renormalize coordinates differ by about 5.2e-8. This is a selected-checkpoint block readout, not retraining-based causal proof. The 512D public branch is initialize_shared applied to mean available CLS/local features, not PF or an FFT branch.

evidence_findings.finding: Missing-view improvements over original DeMo cannot be assigned solely to public identity learning.
evidence_findings.evidence: Original DeMo forwards zeroed missing images through the backbone/reducers/fusion. R201A/B encode_available skips absent backbones, explicitly zeros their features, masks ineligible HDM relations and skips absent relation BN experts. R201A/B also have the public block and partial training.
evidence_findings.interpretation: The normal block readout does not isolate these changes for all49. Both A/B use the same path, so B-versus-A remains the objective comparison. Neither all49 equal-condition means nor the 49 reused query sets are independent replications.

smallest_next_factor.interpretation_limit: A fresh expert has random new weights. Its first-batch retrieval score is an initialization diagnostic and cannot establish useful learned expertise or a dataset-wide bottleneck. It also does not remove the upstream rank64 attention bottlenecks.

minimal_tensor_formula: V[S,b] = mean of conditioned F evidence f1 over source groups in relation S; shape Bx7x3x512.
rho[S] = sum_b pi[S,b], and F[S] = sum_b (pi[S,b]/rho[S])*V[S,b] for eligible relations, using the existing eligibility treatment.
Apply the SAME PF module independently to each F[S]; retain either the chosen P-only interface or the chosen x+P interface consistently, without introducing new projectors.
Scale normalized F[S] direction by the stopped norm of original relation slot r[S], existing alpha_F/gate_F and existing relation mass rho[S]*eligible_count; mask ineligible relations.

Add the resulting delta_F[S] to the corresponding original relation slot, alongside the existing M/I corrections if retained by the predeclared control. Keep the original base tensor untouched and available as state00.

For this identity-only retrieval candidate prefer a natural5120 descriptor in both ordinary-frequency and dual-axis controls; corresponding fused-head/result/evaluator dimension contracts must be explicitly adapted. Do not imply this is dimension-matched to completed R201A/B5632 or hide a zero tail as active capacity.
smallest_relation_coordinate_candidate_a.closed_states: State01 must use independent f0, its own F-only relation/band weights and its own F-only gate; it must not read conditioned f1, full pi, M evidence, psi or I. State10 likewise uses independent m0. relation_frequency_interface.py:23-40 contains the relevant prior formula, but it needs RGBNT201/native validation under the chosen anchor and full/partial interface.
smallest_relation_coordinate_candidate_a.ordinary_frequency_fairness: Give the ordinary-frequency control the same relation-coordinate outlet, scales, heads, dimension and number of active trainable tensors. Preserve its intended unstructured access to all available frequency values; do not describe its merged group slots as physical-source-specific. Do not keep ordinary frequency confined to the old public tail while allowing only dual-axis to modify identity slots.
coupled_changes_that_must_be_disclosed: Relation-specific F pooling must replace the current global Bx512 F collapse; this is required by per-relation injection and cannot be implemented by reshaping the collapsed tensor.
Moving F from the public tail into existing identity slots changes the retrieval geometry. Removing mandatory public25 normalization changes state00 relative to the old fused5632 interface.

A natural5120 output changes the fused neck/classifier and hardcoded descriptor-size metadata in the reused5632 runner/evaluator/native checks. These are real current contracts, not speculative compatibility concerns.

Original E28 has no shared/expert/router/calibrator/fused-head state. These tensors require declared matched initialization; transplanting R201A/B shared heads or MSVR expert heads would change the factor and lineage.

Starting any expert model from E28 is a new common expert baseline relative to R201B. Comparisons among equally initialized paired controls can isolate the outlet choice; R201B versus a combined new expert/metric/outlet model cannot be called a pure bypass or pure frequency factor.
smallest_relation_coordinate_candidate_a.scope: Concrete source-based design direction only. It is a separate outlet experiment after the first diagnostic, not an accepted implementation or automatic authorization to combine several factors in one claimed ablation.

blocking_design_issues_before_formal_R20.evidence: Current residual scales are [.1,.05,.05], projection final weights use std.001, and outputs are normalized before anchor scaling. blocking_design_issues_before_formal_R20.smallest_resolution: Require exact frozen base00, not initial full11 equality. Setting outer scales or final layers to zero to force full11 equality changes initialization and can zero task gradients to earlier expert/router/projection tensors, conflicting with current all-active-gradient gates; do not silently do that or waive the gate.
